purpose: Completion-first subscription team implementation authorized by the user. Stop when useful task delivery is complete; zero new labels, no API fallback.
basis: Observed normal work exceeded the old four-minute session and twenty-minute aggregate windows. Four aggregate model hours and thirty-minute role sessions provide completion headroom;1600 turns/3200 tools aggregate and200 turns/400 tools per session are failsafes, not targets or evidence of abnormality. exceedance: Record exact dimension, observed usage, pending work and recovery; preserve evidence, tasks and spent costs. Emergency ceilings pause recoverably, never mark research failed or complete. Model-only extensions require explicit recorded user direction through Control contract revision; no silent retry, allowance increase or paid fallback.
